text: Lotto is the Belgian National Lottery's own brand: the Lottery's managing director Jannie Haek calls Lotto 'our brand', and the brand has been the cycling team's main partner since 1985.
short: Lotto is the Belgian National Lottery's own brand, on the team since 1985.

source.name: Lotto-Intermarché: Lotto (partner page)
source.quote: Cycling holds a special place in Lotto’s history. Since 1985, our brand has been continuously present in the professional peloton.
